```

**Rationale:** CD74, HLA-DPA1, and HLA-DPB1 are classic MHC class II antigen-presentation genes, strongly enriched in professional antigen-presenting cells (dendritic cells and B cells). WDFY4 and C1orf54 (C1ORF54) are well-documented, relatively specific markers of conventional dendritic cells (particularly cDC1s) in human blood transcriptomic studies, even though they show weaker signal in the CellMarker database. The combination of high MHC-II expression with WDFY4/C1orf54 rather than B-cell-specific markers (e.g., CD19, CD79A) points away from B cells and toward a dendritic cell population.
